title: Agnes and the farmer's will (paraphrase C)
topic: A notary settles an inheritance dispute: Agnes keeps a farmer's will, the son demands the whole farm, the daughter cites the statute that grants each child half, the son's appeal fails, Agnes summons both heirs to a final meeting
tail_E: The settlement is final, and Agnes hands each heir a pen to
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'sign' is the natural continuation of 'Agnes hands each heir a pen to' once the notary's settlement of the inheritance is final; the word and its German equivalents (unterschreiben / unterzeichnen / Unterschrift) occur nowhere in the units or the tail, and no word containing 'sign' is used. ' sign' is a single Pythia token (id 861); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.28, next candidate 'write' ~ 0.21; pilot check for tail selection only, not a result).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase C of family F18 (inheritance dispute, notary Agnes)
notes: Formulation C, domain law: third independent re-phrasing of the ten F18A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Agnes). Replacements include works as a notary in a small town/practises as a notary in a provincial town (arbeitet als Notarin/praktiziert als Notarin), the will lies in her safe/is kept in her safe (liegt/befindet sich), his two children claim the farm/his children demand the farm (beanspruchen/verlangen), reads the will aloud in her office/reads the children the will at her desk (verliest das Testament/liest den Kindern das Testament), the son demands the whole farm for himself/wants the whole farm just for himself (fordert/will), cites the law in a calm voice/invokes the law in a quiet voice (zitiert/beruft sich auf, mit ruhiger Stimme/mit leiser Stimme), the statute grants each child half in such cases/the law gives each child half in these cases (gewährt/gibt), lodges an appeal with the regional court/files a suit with the regional court (geht in Berufung/erhebt Klage), the court dismisses the appeal/rules for the daughter (verwirft die Berufung/gibt der Tochter recht), summons both heirs to a final meeting/asks both heirs to a final appointment (bestellt/bittet). 'praktiziert', 'verlangen', 'erhebt' and 'bittet' are inseparable, 'befindet sich' and 'beruft sich' reflexive, 'gibt recht' a fixed phrase whose adjunct follows it; no separable verbs ('vorlesen', 'anfechten', 'abweisen', 'einladen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
